reviews.pros:
If you are seeing my review being confused wheather to join or not, here are the 5 best points I have observed in DTDC over my 3 years of experience.
1. Your Job Is As Secure As A Govt. Organisation.
2. You will get to learn a lot of new and pratical skills which will definitely help you growing up.
3. If you are lucky & under **Mr. Dhali** trust me your working life will be a dream comes true. He is the bestest best senior I have ever seen.
4. People are very polite & friendly, your colleagues will be your friends within a period of 3-4 weeks. 
5. The working hours is 8 hours (Excluding 30 mins break) which you can't get to see in Kolkata.
See my friend, here you can kick start your career but never expect this kind of flow in other companies else you gonna get cracked hard!!
reviews.cons:
In my opinion dislikes will be the below ones:
1. The behaviour of our regional HR is very unprofessional & ridiculous. She doesn't even know how to talk to someone.
2. You will not get the amount of promotions you deserve, rather some old guy who is wasting their time in this company for last 10 years just sitting around & watching movies will grab a 5000/- bucks promotion infront of you. Hence do not even expect a proper & justified promotion.
3. The working culture & the office ambience is quite unprofessional but friendly. If you are a fresher you will be in a new college 😉
4. Inter departmental politics & lobby will suppress you down, they won't even give you a chance to showcase your tallent & skills. If you disagree with their opinions, you can get humiliated in front of the management.
5. The front desk management is like a nightmare here, starting from the admin to the HR will make you feel how small you are infront of the management & so are your opinions too.
Again, if you are looking for a secure and comfy job then this organisation is like a ripe strawberry 🍓. But if you wanna develop your career then you can seek other options. In Kolkata getting a job is as difficult as finding a niddle in a forest! Hence you have no other option please go for this company.
